extracted.intended_audience: online/digital journalists, newsroom editors, and digital producers
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines and evaluative criteria for producing and judging news content optimized for online platforms, covering newsworthiness, format, engagement, multimedia, SEO, and newsroom operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Immediacy
rubrics_metrics.description: Real-time updates, live blogs, push notifications
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes delivering news as events unfold; use live blogs and push notifications to keep audiences informed in real time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multimedia
rubrics_metrics.description: Combines text, image, audio, video, interactive graphics
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use multiple media types to tell stories — integrate images, audio, video and interactive graphics rather than relying on text alone.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interactive
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enable audience participation through comments and sharing; design experiences that invite user contribution and two-way engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hyper-textuality
rubrics_metrics.description: Linked, networked, connected to other content
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Connect stories through internal and external links, embeds and collections to situate coverage within a broader web of content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timeliness
rubrics_metrics.description: Articles timestamped, live blogs in real time, social media instant
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clearly mark when content was published/updated; prioritize rapid publishing and live coverage where appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Significance
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess whether the story affects the public or addresses important civic or social concerns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Impact
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider the scale of effect — how many people will be influenced or affected by the event or information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Novelty
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize stories with an element of novelty or uniqueness that makes them newsworthy online.

rubrics_metrics.name: Listener / Reader Interest
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Judge stories for their ability to resonate emotionally with audiences; consider human interest and relevance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Headline that works in social feeds
rubrics_metrics.description: Headline that works in social feeds
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Write headlines optimized for social platforms — concise, attention-grabbing, and clear at feed/preview sizes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Image that works at thumbnail size
rubrics_metrics.description: Image that works at thumbnail size
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select or crop images that are legible and compelling when reduced to feed or card thumbnails.

rubrics_metrics.name: First sentence that works above the fold
rubrics_metrics.description: First sentence that works above the fold
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Craft lead sentences that communicate the story quickly for readers who only see the top of the page or preview.

rubrics_metrics.name: Format optimized for mobile
rubrics_metrics.description: Format optimized for mobile (vertical video, short paragraphs)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design content for mobile viewing: short paragraphs, vertical video formats, scannable layouts and fast-loading assets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search-optimized
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use SEO best practices — keyword-aware headlines and copy, metadata, and structure that improve discoverability via search.

rubrics_metrics.name: Shareable
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enable and design for easy sharing: social cards, one-tap share buttons, and preview-friendly content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Click-through prediction
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate how likely a headline/teaser is to drive clicks from social or other referral sources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dwell time prediction
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess whether content is likely to keep readers on the page (longer reads, engaging multimedia, interactive elements).

rubrics_metrics.name: Recirculation potential
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Estimate the probability readers will click to additional stories on the site (related links, calls to action).

rubrics_metrics.name: Subscription-driving potential
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider whether the content encourages paid subscriptions or membership sign-ups (exclusive reporting, high value).

rubrics_metrics.name: Email-newsletter fit
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Judge whether the story is suitable for newsletters and how it can be framed for email audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Image-rich to stop scroll
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use compelling visuals aimed at halting users as they scroll through feeds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Video-embeddable
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide video files or embeds that can be easily inserted into stories and social posts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interactive element potential
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify opportunities for quizzes, maps, timelines or other interactive components that enhance storytelling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data visualization opportunity
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Look for datasets or trends that can be turned into charts, graphs or other visual explanations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Internal links to related coverage
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Connect stories to prior or related reporting via prominent internal links to increase context and recirculation.

rubrics_metrics.name: External links for sources
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Link out to primary sources, documents, and authoritative external material to support claims and transparency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Embed potential for tweets, videos
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use embeds for social posts and video to provide context and amplify source material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Connected to live blogs / collections
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tie individual stories into ongoing live coverage or curated collections to create a persistent entry point for audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Real-time dashboards
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Monitor performance and audience behavior using real-time analytics tools to inform editorial choices.

rubrics_metrics.name: 24/7 desk staffing
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Staff desks around the clock to react to news cycles and publish timely updates when necessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Push notification decisions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Decide which stories merit push notifications and craft concise, appropriate alerts for subscribers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Social platform optimization
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tailor content and presentation for each social platform (format, tone, media type, tagging).

rubrics_metrics.name: A/B headline testing
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use headline experiments to determine which wording best drives engagement and traffic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search-discoverability
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure content can be found via search through SEO, structured data, and good metadata.

rubrics_metrics.name: Social-shareability
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design stories and assets that audiences are likely to share on social networks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mobile-first formatting
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize layout and media choices for mobile devices (fast load times, vertical media, readable typography).

rubrics_metrics.name: Real-time update capability
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Have processes and systems in place to publish timely updates and corrections as events evolve.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multimedia fit
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess whether a story naturally supports or benefits from images, audio, video or interactive elements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interactive component
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate the feasibility and value of including interactive features that engage users more deeply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Topical SEO match
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Match content to current search intent and trending queries to increase visibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subscription value
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Determine whether the content delivers value that can justify or encourage paid subscriptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Email-list fit
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider how well the story works as part of an email communication strategy (timing, tone, headline).

rubrics_metrics.name: Push-notification appropriateness
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Judge whether a story warrants interruptive alerts and craft messages accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reader engagement metrics
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use metrics like dwell time, shares, comments and recirculation to evaluate content performance and newsworthiness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Linkability
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess whether the content provides value or authority that other websites would cite or link to.
